item.title: macOS 27 Golden Gate: The Ars Technica Review
item.description:
📝 The good news is that if you own any Apple Silicon Mac that isn’t falling apart, Golden Gate should run mostly happily. Apple Intelligence requirements Golden Gate introduces a minor split between older Apple Silicon Macs and newer ones. But I would expect to see the gap between older/less-capable Apple Silicon Macs and new ones grow, if and when Apple makes more changes to Apple Intelligence.

item.title: Why a fast-growing German AI startup is moving its parent company from the US
item.description:
📝 Berlin-based Langdock has reversed the usual path taken by European start-ups by moving its parent company from the US to Germany. Langdock has now defied this trend and dismantled its US holding structure and brought its parent company under European law. Langdock has now replaced its US parent company with a European SE.
🔗 Read more: https://www.euronews.com/business/2026/09/16/why-this-fast-growing-german-ai-start-up-is-moving-its-parent-company-from-the-us
